svg.title: Circular-buffer slot map: which stock slots the Palu op reuses, and what they hold (chunk 512, r_k 32, r_v 128, Phase 2)
svg.text: The 32 CB slots: stock flash decode vs the Palu op
stock slot idle in the Palu envelope
slot re-used by the Palu op (small grey line: its stock use)
Extra L1 at chunk 512, r_k 32, Phase 2: roughly 0.6 MB on top of the stock
footprint; c_1 alone grows 120 KB (K_rot is bf16, stock K is bfp8).
At r_k 96 the total reaches ~990 KB of the ~1.41 MB available.
Fig. C2. The op keeps the stock slot numbering so the flash-decode code paths are untouched; the six idle stock features are asserted off so their slots can be borrowed.
